prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, over-the-shoulder shot of a person holding a modern smartphone in their left hand, with the screen facing the viewer. The phone displays a vibrant, magenta-pink app interface featuring a large white thumbs-up icon and bold text that reads "Well Done!" followed by a smaller congratulatory message: "You're taking control of your energy!" The hand holding the phone is relaxed, with the thumb resting gently on the side, and the person is wearing a soft, light gray sweater, adding a cozy, casual touch. The background is softly blurred with warm, ambient lighting, creating a sense of comfort and focus on the phone screen. The overall color palette is dominated by the bright pink of the app, contrasted by the neutral tones of the hand and sweater, and the warm, out-of-focus browns and reds in the background. The composition uses shallow depth of field to draw attention to the phone, evoking a modern, optimistic, and user-friendly atmosphere, as if capturing a moment of personal achievement in a lifestyle or tech advertisement.
